name: Proto-Dravidian
attested_dates: reconstructed; Dravidian attested from Tamil-Brahmi era
region: South Asia (today south/central; Brahui in Baluchistan)
evidence_summary: rebus readings for ~2 dozen signs (Parpola); 'Merchant of the City' (Mahadevan 2014); *piilu 'elephant' loan into Mesopotamian per Mukhopadhyay 2021
label: plausible (leading hypothesis), not established

name: Brahui
proposed_link_to_indus: relic of an Indus-era Dravidian presence
evidence_summary: Elfenbein argues later (medieval) arrival from the south; relic view contested
label: contested

name: Indo-Aryan / Vedic Sanskrit
attested_dates: Rigveda conventionally dated after the Mature Harappan period (exact dates to verify with primary chronology source)
evidence_summary: chronology problem: Mature Harappan c. 2600-1900 BCE vs later Vedic texts; Rajaram horse-seal refuted; Yajnadevam readings fail an informal parser test
label: speculative to fringe

name: Munda / Austroasiatic ('Para-Munda')
proposed_link_to_indus: Witzel: prefixing 'Para-Munda' substrate in early Rigvedic vocabulary; possibly the language of the Indus region
evidence_summary: Witzel 1999 lexical substrate analysis building on Kuiper 1991
label: plausible (as Rigvedic substrate); speculative (as Indus-script language)

name: 'Language X' (Kuiper/Witzel)
proposed_link_to_indus: unidentified substrate associated with geminated consonants
label: speculative

name: Burushaski
evidence_summary: no supporting evidence found this session
label: speculative (unsupported)

name: Elamo-Dravidian
proposed_link_to_indus: genetic link Elamite~Dravidian would tie Indus to Elam
evidence_summary: McAlpin 1981 correspondences; criticised as ad hoc (Krishnamurti, per summaries); Elamite generally treated as isolate
label: contested (minority; largely unaccepted)

name: Meluhhan (language of Meluhha)
proposed_link_to_indus: Mesopotamian words of Meluhhan origin; Witzel argues Meluhha a distinct language area; sesame (Sum. ilu / Akk. ellu) proposed Dravidian etymology vs para-Munda
label: speculative
